issuer: the Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's fee form DMV 201 (dated 10 August 2026, read 2026-10-30) gives a driver's licence only at $4 a year (minimum $20), $32.00, and photo identification at $2 a year (minimum $10, maximum $16); the apply page says a licence is generally valid for up to eight years, so the licence is kept as 8 years at $32.00 and the card as 8 years at $16, the maximum (the card's 8-year term is read from the $2-a-year rate reaching its $16 maximum at eight years, a reading). Code of Virginia 46.2-334.01 (read on the General Assembly's site) restricts licences issued to persons under 18, so a full licence is kept from 18. No youngest age for the card was read.
